samples.prompt: Once upon a time, a little girl found a tiny dragon in her garden.
samples.continuation:
She was very happy and asked her mom if she could do it.
The family smiled and said "Yes, we can try. Let's go to a new nest."
The little girl smiled and they followed the bird's nest. It was very pretty. They took care of the bird's beak and said, "Oh, we can find your home."
The girl was so happy, she thanked the little girl. She thanked her help and went home. The girl and her mom became good friends and played together every day.
